name: invoice-extractor-v1
description: Root helpers; backend app lives in ./backend

scripts.start: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run start --prefix backend
scripts.db:setup:local: npm run db:wait --prefix backend && npm run db:migrate --prefix backend
scripts.test:integration:local: npm run db:setup && npm run test:integration --prefix backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.test:all: npm test --prefix backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:integration --prefix backend
